about.title: L'Histoire Derrière la Construction
about.subtitle: D'une petite chambre au Bénin à la construction de l'infrastructure IA africaine — voici le parcours de quelqu'un qui a refusé d'attendre le futur.
paragraphs: My journey didn't start in a Silicon Valley incubator. It started in a small room with an internet connection and an unstoppable curiosity.

At IFRI in Benin, I quickly realized formal education alone wouldn't let me build the future I envisioned. So I went further — teaching myself Python, diving into data science, and shipping production apps before most peers had written their first loop.
J'ai construit Hypee comme l'écosystème numérique africain, contribué à CosmoLAB Hub, et créé BlackBenAI parce que l'Afrique doit posséder sa propre infrastructure IA.
Today I'm an AI Engineer at Djeemm, founder of BlackBenAI, and builder of multiple products including Donumi, Storya, and Évivi. Between all this, I'm a fullstack developer who ships.
I don't just write code. I build products, create systems, and envision futures.

list.title: BlackBenAI
list.description: Building Africa's next-generation AI infrastructure. BlackBenAI is a vision to create sovereign AI capabilities for Africa — from LLMs trained on African languages to intelligent systems solving local challenges.
list.fullDescription: BlackBenAI is my most ambitious venture. It represents the vision of an Africa that doesn't just consume AI but builds it. The mission spans multiple fronts: developing LLMs fluent in African languages, creating AI products for African markets, and establishing the infrastructure for continental AI sovereignty.
list.problem: Africa relies almost entirely on foreign AI infrastructure. This creates dependency, cultural misalignment, and missed economic opportunities.
list.solution: Build vertically integrated AI capabilities — from data collection and model training to product deployment — designed specifically for African contexts and languages.
list.impact: Democratizing AI access across Africa, preserving linguistic diversity, and creating a self-sustaining AI ecosystem.
list.vision: An Africa that builds its own AI future.

list.title: Hypee
list.description: A comprehensive digital ecosystem designed for African users. Hypee integrates social, commerce, services, and AI into a unified platform experience.
list.fullDescription: Hypee is conceived as the digital super-app for Africa. It combines social networking, e-commerce, service marketplace, and AI-powered assistance into one seamless experience. The platform is built from the ground up with African users in mind — addressing local payment, logistics, and communication patterns.
list.problem: African users navigate fragmented digital experiences across multiple apps not designed for their context.
list.solution: A unified ecosystem that handles social interaction, commerce, services, and AI assistance — all optimized for African users.
list.impact: Reducing digital friction, enabling local commerce, and creating a trusted digital home for African users.

list.title: Donumi
list.description: A digital identity and trust protocol designed for the African context. Donumi enables verified digital identities, reputation systems, and trustless transactions.
list.fullDescription: Donumi addresses the fundamental challenge of digital trust in Africa. By creating a decentralized identity layer, it enables individuals and businesses to establish verifiable digital reputations, conduct trustless transactions, and access services that require identity verification — all while maintaining privacy and control.
list.problem: Lack of trusted digital identity infrastructure limits access to finance, services, and opportunities for millions of Africans.
list.solution: A self-sovereign identity protocol with reputation scoring, verifiable credentials, and privacy-preserving verification.
list.impact: Enabling financial inclusion, reducing fraud, and creating trust infrastructure for the digital African economy.
list.vision: Every African with a digital identity they own.

list.title: Storya
list.description: An AI-powered platform that transforms African stories into interactive, multimedia narratives. Preserving and reimagining African storytelling traditions through technology.
list.fullDescription: Storya is where technology meets Africa's rich oral traditions. The platform uses AI to help users create, share, and experience stories in immersive formats — from text and audio to interactive visual narratives. It's designed to preserve African folklore, document contemporary stories, and create new forms of digital expression.
list.problem: African stories are at risk of being lost in the digital age. Traditional storytelling lacks modern tools for preservation and distribution.
list.solution: An AI-powered storytelling platform that makes it easy to create, preserve, and share African narratives in engaging digital formats.
list.impact: Preserving African cultural heritage, enabling new forms of creative expression, and connecting storytellers with global audiences.
list.vision: Every African story told and preserved forever.

list.title: Évivi
list.description: An AI life assistant platform that helps Africans navigate daily challenges — from health and education to finance and career — through intelligent, personalized guidance.
list.fullDescription: Évivi (meaning "life" in local language) is an AI-powered life intelligence platform. It provides personalized guidance across health, education, finance, and career domains. By understanding the unique context of African users, Évivi delivers actionable insights and recommendations that improve quality of life.
list.problem: Access to personalized guidance and intelligence in critical life domains is limited for most Africans.
list.solution: An AI assistant that understands African contexts and provides personalized guidance across health, education, finance, and career.
list.impact: Improving decision-making and quality of life through accessible, AI-powered personal intelligence.
list.vision: Intelligent life guidance for every African.

list.title: SATCAP
list.description: A suite of AI systems for satellite data processing — detecting CO2 emissions, classifying ocean waste, and providing environmental intelligence.
list.fullDescription: SATCAP is an environmental intelligence platform that processes satellite imagery using AI. It includes modules for CO2 emission tracking (SATCAP CO2), ocean waste detection (SATCAP Ocean), and environmental monitoring. The platform provides real-time insights for climate action and environmental protection.
list.problem: Environmental monitoring requires expensive infrastructure and manual analysis, limiting its accessibility.
list.solution: AI-powered satellite image analysis that automates environmental monitoring at scale, making it accessible and affordable.
list.impact: Enabling data-driven climate action, reducing environmental monitoring costs, and supporting ocean cleanup initiatives.

list.title: AkomptaAI
list.description: A SaaS platform that brings AI to accounting and financial management. Automates financial processes through ML and voice recognition.
list.fullDescription: AkomptaAI is a comprehensive accounting SaaS that leverages AI to automate financial management. Features include intelligent transaction categorization, voice-enabled data entry, automated report generation, and predictive financial analytics.
list.problem: Small and medium businesses struggle with complex accounting processes and lack affordable AI-powered tools.
list.solution: An AI-powered accounting platform that automates financial management, making it accessible and efficient for businesses of all sizes.
list.impact: Democratizing access to AI-powered financial management tools for African businesses.
list.vision: Smart financial management for every business.

list.title: EduShare
list.description: An open-source platform for sharing educational PDFs, with a public API for researchers and developers.
list.fullDescription: EduShare is a participatory platform that enables free sharing of educational documents — courses, revisions, publications. It includes a public API for researchers and developers, making educational resources accessible to everyone.
list.problem: Access to quality educational resources remains limited, especially in developing regions.
list.solution: An open platform where users share educational content freely, with API access for integration with other tools.
list.impact: Democratizing access to educational resources across Africa and beyond.

pillars.title: Innovation depuis l'Afrique
